title: Customizations
description: V9 — Environments. Splits global Configure (Agent Window: connections and skills across every environment and agent, environments, sessions, extensions, Discover with install-to-many) from session Customize (session header button, side panel and composer Connections dropdown, always labeled with the session's environment and agent). Connections get On / Ask first / Off, saved for the workspace or just this session; sign-in is asked only when needed; the panel flags what's missing on this environment; Developer mode shows How it runs.
